prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
blank_sentence: Engineers who studied the system years later described it, above all, as ______.

worlds.passage: In 1983 a small company released the operating system that would run its office computers for the next decade. It was built as one tightly interlocked program that crashed whenever a single part failed, and it was the most advanced system of its day; but the company kept its code secret and sued any rival that copied even a few of its commands. Engineers who studied the system years later described it, above all, as ______.
worlds.explanation: The company kept the code secret and sued anyone who copied it, treating the system as its exclusive property, so engineers called it "proprietary." "Modular" fails because it was one tightly interlocked program. "Resilient" fails because it crashed whenever a single part failed, and "outmoded" fails because it was the most advanced system of its day.

modular.why: a single interlocked program is not built from separable parts

resilient.quote: crashed whenever a single part failed
resilient.why: a system that fails from one fault does not withstand trouble

outmoded.quote: the most advanced system of its day
outmoded.why: it was ahead of its time, not behind it

worlds.passage: In 1983 a small company released the operating system that would run its office computers for the next decade. Its code was freely shared, and it was the most advanced system of its day; it was assembled from separate parts that could each be swapped out on its own, though a fault in any one part still crashed the whole machine. Engineers who studied the system years later described it, above all, as ______.
worlds.explanation: The system was built from separate parts that could each be replaced on its own, so engineers called it "modular." "Proprietary" fails because its code was freely shared. "Resilient" fails because a fault in any one part crashed the whole machine, and "outmoded" fails because it was the most advanced system of its day.

proprietary.why: freely shared code was not kept as the company's exclusive property

resilient.why: one fault brought everything down, so it did not withstand failures

outmoded.quote: the most advanced system of its day
outmoded.why: it was ahead of its time, not behind it
